name: הפרדת משתנים – √(a−x²)·y′ = x(y+b), פתרון כללי (ב) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Solve the following differential equation: \[ {{CT:0}}\frac{dy}{dx}-x(y+{{CT:1}})=0\] Use the letter c to denote the arbitrary constant occurring in the general solution.
y(x) = [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
For the equation \[ {{CT:0}}\frac{dy}{dx} -x(y+ {{CT:1}}) = 0 \] rearranging gives \[\frac{dy}{y+ {{CT:1}}} = \frac{xdx}{{CT:0}}\] To integrate, let \(u = {{CT:2}}-x^2\) giving \(du = -2dx\) \[\int \frac{dy}{y+ {{CT:1}}} = \int\frac{-du}{2{{CT:3}}}\]

Hence \[\ln(|y+{{CT:1}}|) = {{CT:4}}+c\] and \[y + {{CT:1}} = {{CT:5}} = {{CT:6}}=c{{CT:7}}\]
Hence \[y = c{{CT:7}}-{{CT:1}}\]

on_true.feedback: Your answer satisfies the differential equation, but is not in the desired simplest format.
